alphas.paper_title: SemEval-2015 Task 10: Sentiment Analysis in Twitter
alphas.anomaly: Stocks with positive sentiment on Twitter will outperform those with negative sentiment
alphas.rationale: This expression captures the sentiment anomaly by ranking stocks based on their z-score of vwap price over 21 days within each subindustry.

alphas.paper_title: SemEval-2015 Task 10: Sentiment Analysis in Twitter
alphas.anomaly: Stocks with positive sentiment on Twitter will outperform those with negative sentiment
alphas.rationale: This expression exploits the sentiment anomaly by ranking stocks based on the sum of their 10-minute price percentage increases over 21 days and comparing it to a threshold.
